description: This file defines a singleton class LabelsColorMap for managing color mappings for chart labels, including methods for updating, adding, removing, and resetting color schemes, as well as handling multiple chart slices.

classes.name: LabelsColorMap
classes.description: A singleton class managing label color mappings across charts, supporting updates, addition, removal, and scheme management.

methods.name: updateColorMap
methods.description: Updates the color map with a new color scheme, optionally merging with existing labels.

methods.name: addSlice
methods.description: Adds a label and its color to a specific chart slice, updating internal maps.

methods.name: setOwnColorScheme
methods.description: Sets the original color scheme for a specific chart slice.

methods.name: removeSlice
methods.description: Removes a chart slice and its labels from the color map.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears the shared label color map.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Clears all internal maps and resets the singleton state.
